packageRules.description: The Linux runners stay on the oldest supported Ubuntu LTS: the AppImage needs at least the build machine's glibc
The GTK and WebKitGTK bindings must match the versions Tauri (tao, wry) uses; they are updated with Tauri
The Windows bindings must match the version Tauri (wry) uses; they are updated with Tauri
zbus 6 dropped the blocking API that the Linux resume and icon code uses; stay on 5.x
